title: PlanChallenge
description: The plan's challenger's answer: one answer for each practice held by a plan, and the findings for the planner, none when there is nothing to correct.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-33.

answer.description: Whether the plan holds the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, the slice and where the plan breaks it.

practices.description: One answer for each practice held by a plan, by id.

findings.description: What the challenger asks the planner to correct, one sentence each, naming the slice and what to change.
